entries.label: Router Drone Conditional Approvals
entries.text: DoW granted Calix a Conditional Approval for its 7u6.2 router, part number 100-06200, with the approval terminating October 31, 2027.

entries.label: Drone Router Conditional Approvals
entries.text: A later Conditional Approval covered Calix’s GigaSpire class routers—including models 7u6m.2, 7u4txg, 7u4, and 7u6.2—and the Giga Pro (7p6), terminating November 22, 2027.

archive.label: Drone Router Conditional Approvals
archive.text: The FCC concluded that each Conditional Approval is a specific DoW determination that the covered devices do not pose risks to U.S. national security, requiring the Covered List to exclude them.
